scientific_integrity: Analytical proof from facet cross ratios and four disjoint corner cuts; 350 separately implemented half-plane clipping comparisons and 150 direct cross-ratio normalization checks support the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-dimensional square/parallelogram law for unhalved Hilbert distance, ordinary Euclidean area, all interior centers and finite positive radii. No intrinsic Hilbert volume, arbitrary polygon, historical-priority or independently certified claims.
title: Exact Euclidean area of every Hilbert ball in a square: corner-cut law and sharp center stability
